description: UNOSAT and partner damage assessments: Afghanistan is a series of data sets listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange, an open data portal, published or maintained by United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). UNOSAT code: EQ20220622AFG This map illustrates potentially damaged structures/buildings in the northern part of Spera district, Khost province of Afghanistan as detected by Worldview-3 image acquired on 23 June 2022. Within the analyzed area, UNOSAT has identified 170 damaged buildings and 3 road obstacles, amongst the 2800 buildings identified in the analyzed zone. Coverage: Afghanistan. The portal lists 14 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Its tags are earthquake-tsunami, geodata. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEODATABASE, SHP. The portal shows 2022-07-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency shelter and critical facility planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
